title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
theme: small consistent actions, compound growth, discipline
description: 1% daily improvement compounds into 37x better results. Massively viral for motivation + actionable tips.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: In age of constant distraction, deep focused work is rare skill. Trending heavily among students and professionals.

title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
description: Viral for refreshingly honest take on life. Cuts through toxic motivation culture. Gen Z loves counter-narrative approach.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor Frankl
theme: purpose, suffering, resilience, meaning in life
description: Holocaust survivor's philosophy. Deep, emotional content. Perfect for late-night motivational videos. High watch time.

title: Mindset
author: Carol Dweck
theme: growth mindset vs fixed mindset, learning, potential
description: Psychological research backing personal growth. Teachers and students love this. Educational + motivational combo = viral.

title: The 48 Laws of Power
author: Robert Greene
theme: social dynamics, power, influence, human nature
description: Controversial but addictive. Each law makes people think differently. TikTok and YouTube explosion. Dark but engaging.

title: Can't Hurt Me
author: David Goggins
theme: mental toughness, extreme discipline, pushing limits
description: Navy SEAL's raw story. Workout videos + motivation trending massively. Gym bros and motivation seekers flood comments.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
theme: cognitive biases, decision-making, psychology, human behavior
description: Deep psychological insights. Trending among intellectuals. Requires patient viewers but very high engagement quality.

title: The Power of Now
author: Eckhart Tolle
theme: present moment, mindfulness, spiritual growth, anxiety reduction
description: Meditation community loves this. Trending for anxiety relief. Aesthetic visuals + calm narration = algorithm gold.

title: 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen Covey
description: Timeless classic. Used in corporate training. Trending for career + personal growth. Professionals keep rewatching.
